value.rationale: The Heawood graph has a canonical 336-element group and a natural eight-object one-factorization action. Determining the precise nontrivial 1+7+8 decomposition of its 16-dimensional matching homology and quotient homology is a motivated symmetry refinement unavailable from the known nonequivariant wedge or matching counts; not a parameter substitution or table reproduction.
